description: My nights dreaming of crumbl cookies have come to an end 🤣 I saw @Kyra-Mae do this a couple months ago and felt inspired, it was so much fun making these!!  Ingredients:  113g butter 56g oil 100g caster sugar 15g icing sugar 1 egg 1 tsp vanilla extract 300g plain flour 0.25 tsp salt 1 tsp baking powder Vanilla sugar cookie recipe is from lifestyle of a foodie, she also has lots of other flavour recipes too!!  #crumblcookies #crumbl #baking #crumblcookiedupe #bakewithme #baketok
transcript: You no longer have to get a flight to America. I'm gonna show you how you can make your own crumble cookies at home. In a mixing bowl, combine your oil, icing sugar, caster sugar, and softened butter. Then you want to go in with one egg, a teaspoon of vanilla extract, and finally, baking powder, plain flour, and salt. Once that is combined, that is a basic vanilla sugar cookie. You could divide this batter into eight and just have vanilla ones. Like crumble, I wanted to do six different flavors. I weighed out 80 grams per cookie and thought the triple chocolate I went in with two teaspoons of cocoa powder and some chocolate chips. Put that on a tray lined with parchment paper. For the salted caramel one, I went in with one teaspoon of salted caramel sauce and also blobbed a little bit in the middle. For the cinnamon bun one, I went in with a sprinkling of cinnamon and some sultanas. For the bake well, I did a good splash of almond extract and some almond flakes. For the carrot cake, a sprinkling of cinnamon, nutmeg, and some grated carrot. And I had enough dough to make three vanilla ones. Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees for eight to 10 minutes or until the edges are just starting to brown. Come back for part two to see how to decorate them.
